summary.name: edX
summary.one_liner: edX is an online learning platform offering courses, certificates and degrees from universities and companies such as Harvard, MIT, and Stanford.
summary.what_it_does: The page presents edX as a marketplace of online courses, certificate programs and degrees from partner institutions such as Harvard, MIT Sloan, Stanford, Oxford Saïd and Cambridge. Listed topics include artificial intelligence, business strategy and sustainability. Options are described as flexible, hybrid or 100% online. Learners can register for a free account, and an enterprise subscription is offered for employers. The page also lists the edX platform as open-source software under AGPL-3.0 on the awesome-selfhosted list, where it is described as the software that powers the edX.org website.
notable: Courses from Harvard, MIT, Stanford, Oxford and Cambridge
Open-source platform code (AGPL-3.0, Python) listed on awesome-selfhosted
caveats: Certificates and degree programs are paid offerings; the page does not state specific prices beyond a promotional discount code
Page is mostly marketing; specific course costs and terms are not listed
